segments.text: A demon beat Indra and took heaven. No god could kill him. Then he agreed to die. Bala was a demon king, but his heart was kind. He had never refused anyone who asked him for a gift. The gods stood outside heaven with nowhere to go. Bala walked up to them and told them he had always given freely, and he would give again. Whenever they held a yajna, a fire ritual, he would help. Indra smiled. The gods held their yajna. A yajna needs a being to offer to the fire. They bowed to Bala and asked him to offer himself. The hall froze. Bala stood up and came closer and closer. Then he folded his hands and said he was ready. The flames took his body. Then someone cried out. The burnt body was turning into something so bright that no one could look at it. The gods tried to lift it to heaven, but it slipped. It fell to earth and broke into 84 pieces. Wherever they landed, they became jewels. His bones became diamonds. His blood became rubies. His eyes became sapphires. His teeth became pearls. His voice, the voice that said he was ready, became the cat's eye. Nine of those jewels are called the Navratnas. That is why Bala agreed to die. He could never say no to anyone who asked. The gods won heaven by a trick, and the earth won a treasure.
